title: Phone install and push acceptance
acceptance: Owner installs on a phone, receives a reminder push and completes it from the PWA; result recorded
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Owner-observed result recorded in the parent record
escalation: Owner action: this step needs the owner's access, choice or observation

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.5 hours agent + 0.5 hours owner; agent prepares the checklist and records evidence; the owner installs on a phone and completes a pushed reminder. Method: 1.5 h/day judged rate (PR #277). Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.5 kept as history.
